tests.label: Display Test
tests.description: Validates the ST7796 parallel display path, orientation, colors, backlight and basic drawing on the physically verified Panlee pin map.

tests.label: Touch Test
tests.description: Validates the FT6336-family touch controller on I2C address 0x38 and reports touch coordinates through the test firmware.

tests.label: SD Storage Test
tests.description: Runs the normal microSD detection/read-write validation. The separate destructive full-card stress test is intentionally not offered here.

tests.label: Audio Test
tests.description: Exercises the validated I2S audio path using LRCK GPIO35, BCLK GPIO36 and DOUT GPIO37.

tests.label: RS485 Test
tests.description: Exercises the factory-recovered RS485 UART mapping: TX GPIO42, RX GPIO1 and direction/RTS GPIO2 at 115200 baud.

tests.label: External GPIO Test
tests.description: Exercises the externally validated GPIO set used by the lab board acceptance work.

tests.label: Wi-Fi Test
tests.description: Runs the Arduino BSP Wi-Fi validation firmware and reports scan/connectivity information over serial.

tests.label: BLE Test
tests.description: Runs the Bluetooth Low Energy validation firmware for the ESP32-S3 radio path.

tests.label: Full Test Console
tests.description: Loads the interactive consolidated test console for manual board validation after the individual hardware paths are known-good.

tests.label: Retro Clock + Web Setup
tests.description: End-user demo: first-boot setup AP and captive portal, home Wi-Fi provisioning, city/timezone selection, NTP synchronization, local setup page, and a large seven-segment clock with date.

tests.label: LVGL Basic UI
tests.description: Interactive LVGL 8 demo using the WT32_SC01_PLUS BSP for display, touch and backlight: button events, press counter and brightness slider without application-level pin configuration.

tests.label: LVGL Navigation Shell
tests.description: Physically validated four-page LVGL HMI shell with persistent HOME/REMOTE/SETTINGS/INFO navigation, touch page switching, active-page highlighting, remote command placeholders and hardware backlight control.

tests.label: LVGL Device Info
tests.description: Physically validated LVGL HMI demo with live ESP32-S3 device information including chip revision, CPU, Arduino/IDF versions, Flash, PSRAM, heap, sketch space, uptime and touch-controller identity.
